name: oneshot-cli
context: Published package is oneshot-ship and the executable is oneshot.
Version source of truth is package.json; docs/index.html must stay in sync when visible version changes.
After publishing, install and verify the CLI locally, on dappnode, and on andrew-dev when release scope says everywhere.

prompt_routes.context: For oneshot-cli releases, run npm pack --dry-run, publish the new oneshot-ship version, then verify npm view and `oneshot --version` on local, dappnode, and andrew-dev.
Remote CLI verification should inspect the active Bun global install, not just the checkout.
